metrics.model_source: dispatching session's model, read from get_session at record time (configured: claude-opus-5; last served: claude-opus-5). A subagent inherits the parent model unless the harness overrides it, and the hand-back does not report which model served the turn — so this is the session's model, not an independent observation of the subagent's.

witnesses.notes: Every assertion in the original survives: CRDM is still expanded identically and still attributed to the Public Health Informatics Institute; it still governs feature requests, platform changes and content-pipeline work; the trigger is still a user, reviewer or editor asking for capability rather than content; the three examples remain a new block kind, a rendering change and a QA criterion — all terms of art intact and unaltered in scope; and the consequence is still that the agent enters a CRDM-guided workflow instead of improvising. Deliberately NOT counted as drift: 'content-pipeline evolution' to 'content-pipeline changes', which loses a shade of ongoing development but asserts nothing different and leaves the referent unchanged; likewise 'framework from' to 'originating from', 'not content but capability' to 'not a matter of content but of capability', 'a rendering change' to 'a change to rendering', and the added articles in 'a user, a reviewer, or an editor'. No claim was added, dropped, weakened, strengthened or reversed, and no named entity or quantifier moved.

Back-translation: How folio-assistant uses the Collaborative Requirements Development Methodology (CRDM) — a structured, participatory framework originating from the Public Health Informatics Institute — to manage feature requests, platform changes, and content-pipeline changes. When a user, a reviewer, or an editor asks for something that is not a matter of content but of capability — a new block kind, a change to rendering, a QA criterion — the agent enters a CRDM-guided workflow rather than improvising a solution.

Flagged as ambiguous while rendering: 'les évolutions de la plateforme et celles du pipeline de contenu' — 'évolutions' could be evolutions, developments or enhancements; the elliptical 'celles du' required repeating the noun in English · 'issu du Public Health Informatics Institute' — rendered 'originating from'; could be 'coming out of' or 'developed by' · 'un nouveau type de bloc' — 'type' may be the domain term 'kind' or plainly 'type' · 'un changement de rendu' — 'a change to rendering' vs 'a rendering change' vs 'a change in rendered output' · 'qui ne relève pas du contenu mais de la capacité' — the content/capability contrast is idiomatic · 'un flux de travail guidé par la CRDM' — 'guidé par' could be 'driven by' or 'governed by'
